title: Analytics show demonstration figures and cannot render actual API reports
steps: Sign in as QA admin after the linked deal is won. Open Analytics.
expected: The actual QA revenue and records appear in KPIs and detailed reports.
actual: Cards still show $2.4M pipeline and $850K revenue; sales and revenue sections remain Loading; lead analytics show [object Object]. Backend response shapes differ from dashboard.js assumptions.
fix: Align dashboard renderers and KPI keys with the actual response schemas; replace placeholder values and handle empty/error states.

title: Deal creation is unreachable and editing silently ignores the selected stage
steps: Open Deals. Observe that no Add Deal control exists. Edit QA Linked Deal, select Proposal, and Save Deal.
expected: Users can create opportunities and save the chosen stage.
actual: No create trigger is exposed. Edit initially has a blank stage; selecting stage 3 and saving leaves stage 2. The form sends pipeline_stage_id while the API requires stage_id; the equivalent create payload returns 422.
fix: Expose creation, populate stage_id correctly, and assert persistence against the real API.

title: Lead company and contact fields are discarded on save
steps: Add a lead with contact QA Contact Buyer and company QA Lifecycle Company. Save and reload.
expected: The entered relationships are saved and shown.
actual: Both columns show N/A after reload. The form sends contact_name and company_name, which are absent from LeadCreate; the backend expects contact_id and company_id.
fix: Use linked record selectors and persist IDs; reject unsupported fields where silent loss would hide mistakes.

title: Relationship names do not match API response fields
steps: View the created contact, the assigned task, and global search results for buyer@qa.example.com.
expected: Company, assignee, and contact names are visible.
actual: Contact company is N/A; the assigned task says Unassigned; contact search results show email without contact names. Renderers expect nested company and assignee.full_name or first_name/last_name, while these responses expose IDs or name.
fix: Join or resolve relationship data and define consistent response contracts for list and search views.

title: Customer and deal details retain unrelated placeholder content
steps: Open QA Lifecycle Company and QA Linked Deal from their real record links.
expected: The main record identity and linked contacts, tasks, and activities reflect the selected record.
actual: The sidebar brand heading changes to the record title while main details still describe Acme. The linked QA contact, task, and call are absent. Timeline rendering expects events instead of the API items collection.
fix: Bind the main detail sections and timeline to the selected record and remove sample customer data.

title: Pagination does not advance and list counts are fabricated
steps: Create more than 20 companies, open Companies, then click the next-page arrow.
expected: Rows change to the next page and counts reflect stored data.
actual: Twenty rows remain unchanged; footer says Showing 1 to 10 of 1,248 entries. JS sends skip/limit while the API accepts page/page_size, and pagination buttons are not wired. Similar list code exists for contacts and leads.
fix: Use the API paging contract, bind navigation and render counts; test first, middle, last and filtered pages.

title: Workflow automation is a nonpersistent interface
steps: Open workflow page and click Save Workflow.
expected: The rule is persisted and can trigger its configured action.
actual: No write request occurs and OpenAPI exposes no workflow/automation endpoint. pipeline.js replaces the workflow canvas with a deal board.
fix: Implement persistence and trigger execution, or remove automation from the accepted release scope and interface.

title: Assignments generate no notifications and notification page shows sample records
steps: Assign QA Assigned Task to the representative and check that user notifications. Seed a controlled notification, then open Notifications.
expected: Assignment generates a notification and the page can show, read, and delete actual notifications.
actual: Assignment produces an empty list. A manually seeded notification exists in the API but never appears on the page, which keeps sample Acme messages. notifications_page.js has no matching list container. Notification API unit tests pass with directly seeded fixtures.
fix: Generate notification events for assignments/deadlines and connect the notification page to a real list target and actions.

title: Administrator user creation is unavailable in the interface
steps: As administrator, open User Management and click Add User.
expected: A working form creates an account with the intended role and status.
actual: No form or dialog opens. The page script only loads data; it has no add/edit/deactivate handlers. User names also fall back to email because it expects full_name.
fix: Implement administrator user actions with explicit validation and corresponding backend authorization.

title: Profile and preferences do not save
steps: In Settings change the displayed first name Jane, click Save Changes, and reload.
expected: The current user profile is shown and the changed value persists.
actual: There is no write request and Jane returns. Initial fields contain a demonstration identity; only email is updated. settings.js reads full_name although the API exposes name and has no save handler.
fix: Populate real profile data, bind save to /users/me, and persist supported preferences with success/error feedback.

title: CSV exports preserve executable spreadsheet formulas
steps: Create a company named =1+1 and export companies as CSV.
expected: Untrusted cell text is exported safely for spreadsheet consumers.
actual: The row includes 3,=1+1 without neutralization. csv.DictWriter quoting alone does not prevent spreadsheet formula interpretation. No spreadsheet execution was attempted.
fix: Neutralize formula-leading characters in exported text and verify with safe spreadsheet fixtures.

title: Password validation accepts weak values and returns 500 for long values
steps: Register one QA account with password x and another with 100 ASCII a characters.
expected: An agreed password policy is enforced; invalid lengths return validation errors.
actual: One-character password registration succeeds with 200; the 100-character password returns 500 due to bcrypt input handling, with a traceback in this development configuration.
fix: Validate password policy and byte limits before hashing, and return controlled errors for invalid input.

title: Profile and administrator user edits omit audit events
steps: Read audit logs; update /users/me and change the representative role with PUT /users/{id}; read logs again.
expected: Each important change records actor, target, operation and timestamp.
actual: The audit list remains 59 entries. Login and CRM events are logged, but these user updates are not. The role was restored after testing.
fix: Add transactional audit events for profile, role, active-state and other administrative updates.

title: Accessibility defects affect controls images contrast and modal keyboard use
steps: Run axe WCAG A/AA scans on the 11 named pages; open New Company and press Escape.
expected: Controls have accessible names, images have suitable alternatives, contrast is readable, and dialogs manage focus and dismissal.
actual: Ten pages have serious/critical rule findings: 88 element findings across 25 page/rule occurrences. Modal lacks dialog/aria-modal semantics, focus remains on the opener, and Escape does not close it.
fix: Associate labels, name selects/links, add image alternatives, correct contrast, and implement dialog focus handling and keyboard dismissal.

title: Several pages overflow mobile and tablet viewports
steps: Open six major pages at widths 320, 390 and 768 CSS pixels.
expected: Page content fits the viewport, with intentional scrolling limited to appropriate components.
actual: Eleven of 18 combinations have body overflow. At width 320: Contacts is 742px, Settings 731px, workflow 2132px. Workflow also overflows desktop at 2392px versus 1440px viewport.
fix: Contain wide boards/tables and fix responsive grids, fixed widths, sidebars and form sizing.

title: Global search omits tasks assigned to the current representative
steps: As representative, GET /tasks and search for QA Assigned.
expected: Search includes tasks the user can access through assignment.
actual: The task is present in /tasks but absent from /search. Search owner filtering makes the assigned_to branch unreachable when owner_id exists.
fix: Apply the same owner-or-assignee permission predicate to task lists and search.

title: Role affordances disagree with backend permissions
steps: Open User Management as sales_manager and Tasks as viewer.
expected: Navigation and writable controls reflect the permissions actually enforced by the API.
actual: Manager is admitted to the page but users table says Insufficient permissions because API is admin-only. Viewer sees three enabled task-completion checkboxes. API writes remain protected; no privilege bypass was observed.
fix: Align frontend capabilities and route guards with backend permissions; disable or omit viewer write controls.

title: Activity creation has no usable entry point
steps: Open Tasks and Activities and look for Add Activity or Log Activity.
expected: Users can log calls, meetings, emails and notes.
actual: No activity creation button exists on this page. The latent handler sends activity_type but ActivityCreate requires type. API creation works with the correct payload.
fix: Provide a labeled activity form and submit the actual schema fields.

title: Validation accepts meaningless names and reversed report date ranges
steps: POST a company name containing only spaces; GET /reports/sales with start_date after end_date.
expected: Invalid names and reversed ranges return clear validation errors.
actual: Whitespace company saves with 200; reversed report range returns 200 with empty totals. Dashboard endpoints do reject reversed ranges, so behavior is inconsistent.
fix: Trim and validate meaningful names and share date-range validation across dashboard and reports.

title: Installed frontend tooling has reported dependency advisories
steps: Run npm audit --json from the frontend directory.
expected: Supported tooling has no unaddressed high-severity advisories.
actual: Audit reports three affected package entries: Vite high, source-map-js high and esbuild moderate. They are development dependencies; production exploitability was not demonstrated. This instance uses the Vite development server on Windows.
fix: Upgrade supported tooling and transitives, review advisory applicability, and rerun functional/browser tests. Do not use the development server as a production host.

title: Build command does not produce the output required by preview
steps: Run npm run build followed by npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5175.
expected: Documented build and preview scripts work together.
actual: Build only prints Static HTML app, no build required. Preview exits because dist does not exist. This does not prove static hosting itself is impossible.
fix: Choose and document a real Vite build or a coherent static hosting/preview path and validate it in CI.

title: Calendar Automations and Reports sidebar entries are dead links
steps: Open Analytics and inspect or activate the Calendar, Automations and Reports sidebar links.
expected: Each entry opens an implemented destination.
actual: All three retain href="#" after app initialization. bindSidebarNav lacks corresponding mappings for these exact labels.
fix: Connect implemented destinations and remove or clearly disable unavailable features.

title: Company table headings describe different data from the rendered cells
steps: Open Companies with the QA Lifecycle Company fixture. Compare Size, Annual Revenue and Owner headers with the actual cells.
expected: Headings and values describe the same attributes.
actual: companies.js renders website, phone and city/country in columns whose HTML headings are Size, Annual Revenue and Owner. This mislabels business data.
fix: Align table headings, row fields and sorting/filtering semantics to a single column definition.
checks: companies.js lines 63 to 66 and Companies HTML table headings
